sections.title: Big numbers for prices
sections.content: Forint prices are big numbers. You know *száz* (100). The other hundreds put the digit in front and write it as one word: *kétszáz* (200), *háromszáz* (300). The 2 is *két* here, as before a noun. A thousand is *ezer*, and *kétezer* is 2000. Tens and units follow in the same word: *kétszázötven* (250), *ezerötszáz* (1500).

items.english: A kilo of apples is 400 forints.

sections.content: *Száz* and *ezer* need no *egy*: 100 forints is just *száz forint*. The noun stays singular after any number, so it is *háromszáz forint*, never *forintok*, just as *három szék* has no plural.
